body: {"better": "B", "reason": "Card A uses English word 'Park' in 'పార్కులో' when venue name Bozeman Pond Park already contains it; Card B uses only Telugu 'పార్కులో' without extra English. Also Card A's 'నడవండి' is imperative/command form to father, slightly less respectful than B's descriptive '15 నిమిషాల నడక తర్వాత అక్కడికి చేరుకోవచ్చు'. B's 'కాసేపు' is slightly more natural coastal Andhra phrasing for spending time."}
